finding_verbatim: C L Chau pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that leaving the 200 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of NATURAL NUMBERS, resulting in NATURAL NUMBERS losing its rightful running and being checked when crowded between GOOD LUCK BABE and SHANNON GLOW. C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 23 December 2026 and to expire on Wednesday, 30 December 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays). In addition, Jockey Chau was fined $90,000. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his poor race riding record.
notes: Suspension 23/12/2026-30/12/2026 (resumes 30/12), $90,000 fine. Also severely reprimanded in same race (improving into a run approaching 150m / shifting out).
